verdict.rationale: xAI publishes dated retirement guides, such as the May 15, 2026 retirement, that list the affected slugs in advance. The guides document an automatic-redirect policy to grok-4.3 so existing code keeps working, and they state the pricing impact. Model aliases, pinned versioned IDs and the models endpoint further support planned migration. Missing for 10: a standing written deprecation policy with a guaranteed minimum notice period, per-model end-of-life dates or a lifecycle table, behavioral migration guidance beyond the auto-redirect, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how retirements play out.
